title: RNA/DNA Extraction from Plankton Samples Using NucleoSpin Kits
author: Sarah Romac

steps.title: Lyse Plankton Filter Samples
steps.instruction: Lyse the plankton filter samples following the cryogrinding protocol (https://www.protocols.io/edit/cryogrinding-protocol-mecanic-lysis-of-142mm-filte-beqpjdvn).

steps.title: Select Extraction Kit Based on Size Fraction
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate NucleoSpin kit based on the plankton size fraction and collection method.

substeps.instruction: For >20µ size fractions (plankton net): Use NucleoSpin RNA MIDI kit.
For <20µ size fractions (Niskin/pumping, 142mm filters): Use NucleoSpin RNA MIDI and MINI kits.
For <20µ size fractions (Niskin/pumping, 47mm filters): Use NucleoSpin RNA MINI kits.

steps.title: Perform RNA MINI Extraction (<20µ, 47mm filters)
steps.instruction: Extract RNA/DNA using the NucleoSpin RNA MINI kit for small size fractions on 47mm filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 500µL RA1 and 5µL β-mercaptoethanol to the filter powder in a Falcon50 tube; vortex thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer lysate and filter to a Nucleospin Filter (violet ring) in a 2mL Collection Tube; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C).
Discard the filter and transfer eluate (~550 µL) to a new sterile 2mL microtube.
Add 700µL 70% EtOH to the filtrate (~1250 µL total) and pipette up and down at least 5 times to mix.
Transfer 600µL of the mix to a NucleoSpin RNA column (light blue ring) in a Collection Tube; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Repeat until all volume is passed.
Add 500µL DNA Wash to the column; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through.
Add another 500µL DNA Wash; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in an annotated 1.5mL sterile microtube.
Dry the column for 3 min at room temperature.
Add 100µL DNA Elute (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C).
Store DNA extracts at -20°C.

Prepare DNase mix (90µL Reaction Buffer + 10µL reconstituted rDNase per sample; e.g., 900µl+10µl for 10 samples, 1530µl+170µl for 17 samples). Apply 95µL DNase Mix to the column center and incubate 15 min at room temperature.
Add 200µL RAW2 to inactivate rDNase; incubate 1 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Place column in a new Collection Tube.
Add 600µL RA3; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and replace column in Collection Tube.
Add 250µL RA3; centrifuge for 2 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in an annotated sterile microtube.
Add 30µL RNase-free water (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 1 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C).
Repeat elution with the same eluate, then discard the column.
Store RNA extracts at -80°C.

steps.title: Perform RNA MIDI Extraction (>20µ or <20µ 142mm)
steps.instruction: Extract RNA/DNA using the NucleoSpin RNA MIDI kit for larger size fractions or 142mm filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.6 mL RA1 and 36 µL β-mercaptoethanol to the filter powder in a Falcon50 tube; vortex thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer lysate and filter to a Nucleospin Filter in a 15mL Collection Tube; centrifuge for 10 min at 4500g (19°C).
Discard the filter and transfer eluate (~3.7 mL) to a new sterile Falcon15mL tube.
Add 4 mL 70% EtOH to the filtrate (~7.7 mL total) and vortex 2 x 5 sec to mix.
Transfer 3 mL of the mix to a NucleoSpin RNA MIDI column in a 15mL Collection Tube; centrifuge for 3 min at 4500g (19°C). Repeat until all volume is passed.
Add 2.5mL DNA Wash to the column; centrifuge for 3 min at 4500g (19°C). Discard flow-through.
Add another 2.5mL DNA Wash; centrifuge for 3 min at 4500g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in a new sterile Falcon15mL.
Dry the column for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 300µL DNA Elute (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 5 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 3 min at 11000g (19°C).
Transfer DNA extract to an annotated 1.5mL sterile microtube and store at -20°C.

Prepare DNase mix (235µL Reaction Buffer + 25µL reconstituted rDNase per sample; e.g., 2350µl+250µl for 10 samples, 3995µl+425µl for 17 samples). Apply 235µL DNase Mix to the column center and incubate 15 min at room temperature.
Add 2.6mL RAW2 to inactivate rDNase; incubate 1 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 3 min at 4500g (19°C). Place column in a new Collection Tube.
Centrifuge again for 3 min at 4500g (19°C) and place column in a new Collection Tube.
Add 2.6mL RA3; centrifuge for 5 min at 4500g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in a new Falcon 15mL tube.
Add 300µL RNase-free water (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 2 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 3 min at 4500g (19°C).
Repeat elution with the same eluate, then discard the column.
Transfer RNA extract to an annotated 1.5mL sterile microtube and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Perform Combined MIDI/MINI Extraction (<20µ, 142mm)
steps.instruction: Extract RNA/DNA using a combination of MIDI and MINI kits for <20µ size fractions on 142mm filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.6 mL RA1 and 36 µL β-mercaptoethanol to the filter powder in a Falcon50 tube; vortex thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer lysate and filter to a Nucleospin Filter in a 15mL Collection Tube; centrifuge for 10 min at 4500g (19°C).
Discard the filter and transfer eluate (~3.7 mL) to a new sterile Falcon15mL tube.
Add 4 mL 70% EtOH to the filtrate (~7.7 mL total) and vortex 2 x 5 sec to mix.
Transfer 600µL of the mix to a NucleoSpin RNA column (light blue ring) in a Collection Tube; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Repeat until all volume is passed.
Add 600µL DNA Wash to the column; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through.
Add another 600µL DNA Wash; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C).
Dry the column for 3 min at room temperature.
Add 100µL DNA Elute (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 2 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C). Place column in a new 2mL Collection tube.
Take a 5µL aliquot for quantification (Qubit, Bioanalyzer, Nanodrop). Store DNA extracts at -20°C.

Prepare DNase mix (90µL Reaction Buffer + 10µL reconstituted rDNase per sample; e.g., 900µl+10µl for 10 samples, 1530µl+170µl for 17 samples). Apply 95µL DNase Mix to the column center and incubate 15 min at room temperature.
Add 200µL RAW2 to inactivate rDNase; incubate 1 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Place column in a new Collection Tube.
Add 600µL RA3; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and replace column in Collection Tube.
Add 600µL 96-100% EtOH; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and replace column in Collection Tube.
Add 30µL RNase-free water (preheated to 50°C) to the membrane; incubate 2 min at room temperature and centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C).
Repeat elution with the same eluate, then discard the column.
Process directly to TurboDNase treatment (Turbo-DNA free TM kit, Ambion AM1907).
Wash NucleoSpin column: Add 600µL DNA Wash; centrifuge for 1 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in an annotated 1.5mL sterile microtube.
Add 600µL RA3; centrifuge for 30s at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and replace column in Collection Tube.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 11000g (19°C). Discard flow-through and place column in an annotated 1.5mL sterile microtube.
